rng_reset: once per clip, never between windows
history_source: ARDY self-history; no common idle and no live Unity body pose supplied

results.name: left-wave

record.text: While standing in place, a person who is standing waves the left hand with moderate movements at a moderate pace.

results.selection_reason: Previously reviewed left-wave sample; moderate amplitude and pace.

head_motion_diagnostics.basis: Head local +Z forward relative to Spine3; Y-up, yaw=atan2(x,z), pitch=atan2(-y,hypot(x,z))
head_motion_diagnostics.limitation: Head-direction range is a visibility screen, not human verification of repeated nodding or shaking.

results.name: right-wave

record.text: While standing in place, a standing person waves the right hand with moderate movements at a moderate pace.

results.selection_reason: Moderate right-wave is in validation, not the final test split.

head_motion_diagnostics.basis: Head local +Z forward relative to Spine3; Y-up, yaw=atan2(x,z), pitch=atan2(-y,hypot(x,z))
head_motion_diagnostics.limitation: Head-direction range is a visibility screen, not human verification of repeated nodding or shaking.

results.name: nod

record.text: While standing in place, a standing person nods the head with small movements at a moderate pace.

results.selection_reason: No moderate-amplitude nod is held out; retain the small-amplitude test sample.

head_motion_diagnostics.basis: Head local +Z forward relative to Spine3; Y-up, yaw=atan2(x,z), pitch=atan2(-y,hypot(x,z))
head_motion_diagnostics.visibility_criterion: pitch peak-to-peak >= 8 degrees and pitch >= yaw
head_motion_diagnostics.limitation: Head-direction range is a visibility screen, not human verification of repeated nodding or shaking.

results.name: shake-head

record.text: While standing in place, a person standing on the floor shakes the head from side to side with large movements at a moderate pace.

results.selection_reason: No moderate-amplitude head shake is held out; retain the large-amplitude test sample.

head_motion_diagnostics.basis: Head local +Z forward relative to Spine3; Y-up, yaw=atan2(x,z), pitch=atan2(-y,hypot(x,z))
head_motion_diagnostics.visibility_criterion: yaw peak-to-peak >= 10 degrees and yaw >= pitch
head_motion_diagnostics.limitation: Head-direction range is a visibility screen, not human verification of repeated nodding or shaking.

limitations: Offline continuation inputs, not a live streaming service or live avatar history test.
First window cold-starts; there is no shared initial stance across descriptions.
Seam metrics measure adjacent poses, and include normal motion; they are not ground-truth errors.
ARDY re-encodes supplied history. Returned history is measured but never replaces previously appended frames.
Cached template descriptions only; right-wave is a validation sample, and no model selection is performed here.
No motion correction, retargeting, visual acceptance, or instruction-compliance claim.
Timings include ARDY generation and decoding, with no warmup; exclude feature encoding, loading and Unity.
